## Mandatory SOP checklist
- [ ] Read `AGENTS.md` and `MODIFICATION_CHECKLIST.md` on the target branch before editing.
- [ ] Confirmed target branch, current HEAD, acceptance criteria, and relevant CI status.
- [ ] Reviewed affected code/config/docs/tests/deployment files and cross-file dependencies.
- [ ] Added or updated tests and documentation/config examples where required.
- [ ] Ran applicable SOP §5 tests and syntax checks; results are recorded below.
- [ ] Reviewed the final diff for regressions, unrelated changes, accidental deletions, and secrets.
- [ ] Checked CI for the exact latest commit SHA.
- [ ] Applied SOP §1 and explicitly decided whether/how to sync `main`; no point-name-only code was ported.
- [ ] Distinguished CI/test results from production verification.
- [ ] Recorded rollback considerations and all unverified/blocked items.
